newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Electric sets up holding firm in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Electric sets up holding firm in Europe.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday that it has set up a holding company in London to manage its European operations.
The holding company was established in order to respond quickly and properly to the rapid changes in the European Union, the company said in a statement.
The holding company will hold the shares of 16 sales and finance companies, and other Matsushita group companies in Europe, it said.
The function of the existing regional headquarters, Panasonic Europe (Headquarters) Ltd, will be transferred to the new company which is expected to start operating on April 1, it said.
